verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a hosted email service, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a Fastmail setting or policy that lets users disable telemetry, analytics or usage tracking. Community remarks about data-handling transparency and jurisdiction are adjacent privacy topics, not an opt-out control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
